title: Run exact portfolio counts after every list adjustment
trigger_preconditions: A count-sensitive portfolio list is edited by removing or restoring entries.
failure_signature: The first post-patch preflight reported thirty-nine refinement tasks instead of the required forty.
candidate_workaround: Restore one explicitly scoped refinement entry and rerun all five portfolio counts before generation.
recurrence_guard: Use executable cardinality checks after list edits rather than mental subtraction.
rollback: Do not freeze or credit the mismatched portfolio; keep the preflight result as a failed witness.
scope_boundary: Owner-local preregistration cardinality only; no x1 freeze, scientific, authority, or independent-reproduction credit.
